title: expert: add a new expert group for dissector bugs.
description:
A dissector bug means that the *dissector* is malformed, not that the
*packet* is malformed. Add PI_DISSECTOR_BUG and use that for the
DissectorError exception.

Ping #19720 - this isn't the underlying bug there, but that bug does
show that the underlying bug was misreported as a malformed packet
rather than as a dissector bug.
